label: Attorney
blurb: You practiced law. You know what a contract is hiding and what a deposition is for.
outcome: In tribunal and personnel matters you will be believed immediately. You already have half a canon law degree's worth of instinct, and the chancellor will notice.

label: Accountant or financial analyst
blurb: You closed books, found errors, and once found something that was not an error.
outcome: You can audit a parish and find what the last pastor hid. The diocesan finance office will want you before you are ordained.
trait: the books do not lie to him

label: Corporate management
blurb: You ran teams, budgets, and meetings that ended on time.
outcome: You run a meeting. Staff will follow you and delegation will come naturally, which in a rectory is a kind of miracle.

label: Teacher
blurb: A classroom, thirty adolescents, and a bell schedule.
outcome: You hold a room of the unwilling. Youth ministry and the parish school will be easier for you than for anyone, and vocations will come from your classrooms.
trait: holds a room of the unwilling

label: Professor or researcher
blurb: You taught at a university, published, and sat on committees that decided nothing.
outcome: You are published. The academic track opens to you immediately, and the seminary faculty will treat you as a colleague who happens to be a student, which is awkward for everyone.

label: Physician or nurse
blurb: You have been on the floor at three in the morning when it went wrong.
outcome: You have been present at deaths, and it shows. Hospitals, hospices, and the bioethics questions will come to you, and no one will ever mistake your piety for softness.

label: Military officer
blurb: You gave orders and took them, and you know which is harder.
outcome: Crises will find you calm. Chaplaincy will find you. Some of the faculty will find you rigid, and one or two of the men will find you the only adult in the building.

label: Trades or construction
blurb: You built things, or fixed them, and you know what the estimate should say.
outcome: No degree, and it does not matter. When the roof leaks you will know who is lying, and the blue-collar parishes will decide you are one of them the first time you pick up a tool. Deliberately strong, and the faculty will underrate you for years.
trait: knows what the estimate should say

label: Journalism or communications
blurb: You wrote on deadline and watched what happened after it ran.
outcome: You know how this will be reported. When the diocese has a bad week, someone will call you, and when you have a bad week, you will know exactly what the story will say.
trait: knows how this will be reported

label: Social work or nonprofit
blurb: Caseloads, agencies, and the exact form that gets a family a bed for the night.
outcome: You know which agency to call. The poor, the addicted, and the paperwork that stands between them and help will be your competence, and the St. Vincent de Paul society will love you on sight.
